subject: planner: address collation ambiguity in scalar function construction during predicate simplification. (#57049)
summary: Reviewed the planner-only change in `pkg/planner/core/rule_predicate_simplification.go`: it replaces `expression.NewFunctionInternal` with error-returning `expression.NewFunction` in two scalar-function construction sites and conservatively skips simplification when function construction fails (likely due to collation derivation ambiguity), avoiding nil-expr propagation/panics while preserving SQL semantics by not pruning branches on uncertain comparisons. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the planner changes.
